description:
In this video, we’re taking you on an exciting journey to Bandarban. We stayed at a brand-new, budget-friendly spot called Adrok Garden Resort, and we’ll be sharing our full experience from the road trip to Bandarban, to the resort stay, delicious food, and all the adventures we explored along the way. Stay tuned till the end, and we hope you enjoy traveling with us! 🌿


We appreciate you watching the full vlog!
If you enjoyed it, don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe 👉 @SilviaShadman 💕
